## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: /dso:fp-recovery accepts DESIGN.md lint findings as eligible false-positive escape candidates

## Implementation
Modify plugins/dso/skills/fp-recovery/SKILL.md to document that DESIGN.md lint violations qualify for FP-recovery. Add to When to invoke section. Clarify the finding format and common FP patterns.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] DESIGN.md lint findings documented in FP-recovery skill
  Verify: grep -qi 'design.md\|design-md-lint' plugins/dso/skills/fp-recovery/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
